location_name: Tiwi Carbon Study fire experiment, western Melville Island
description: Eucalypt open forest (mesic savanna) co-dominated by Eucalyptus miniata, Eucalyptus tetrodonta and Corymbia nesophila; C4 grass understorey (Chrysopogon, Sorghum, Eriachne) with multi-stemmed woody resprouts.
soil type: strongly weathered red earths with variable ironstone gravel; nutrient-poor kandosols
locality: Imalu, Shark Bay (A, B, C), Taracumbi and Pikertaramoor, western Melville Island, Tiwi Islands
notes: Tiwi Carbon Study centroid (Chapter 3, Appendix S1). Growth response data from the six annual and six unburnt treatment sites. Annual sites burnt in the early dry season since plantation establishment (2005/06); unburnt sites fire-excluded since then.

description: Fire-excluded eucalypt savanna dominated by sapling-sized trees after 10 years without fire.
locality: southern end of the Imalu unburnt treatment site, opposite the Imalu annual treatment site, north-west Melville Island
notes: Coordinates from 11°15'22"S, 130°26'31"E (Chapter 2 p.48; Chapter 5 p.157; degree symbols lost in the PDF). Unburnt since 2005. Trait dataset sampling site for the 12 study species and Ficus scobina.

description: Savanna on the Palmerston escarpment; burnt only two or three times in the past 15 years; sampled trees showed no evidence of fire impact.
locality: Palmerston escarpment, near Darwin, mainland Northern Territory
notes: Coordinates from 12°29'24"S, 130°59'24"E (Chapter 2 p.48; text garbled as 12.29'24"S, 13059'24"E). Trait dataset sampling site for Xanthostemon paradoxus, Gardenia megasperma and Corymbia porrecta (May 2015).
